purpose: Teach: ことわざ/虫歯/ふんだんに/かぶり/豆乳/もてる/そういや/覗く

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔のことわざ、本気で、絶対、深い、知恵、感じるよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、現代にも、繋がる、本気、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: You remember those old proverbs, don't you? The kind with real wisdom that still matters today.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle cadence, as if speaking half to her and half to the past. Steady breath. Slight rise at the question, inviting her to meet him there.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、本気で、絶対、虫歯、なくて、お互いに、健康だったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、本気で、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Back when we were young, we were both so healthy—no cavities, no worries. You remember that, don't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, settling into the memory. Slightly breathy on the recall. Gentle smile underneath. Slows on the intimate address at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お料理、ふんだんに、絶対、振る舞ってくれたよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、感謝。
lines.en: Your grandfather used to give us such generous portions when he cooked. You remember that, don't you? I'm still grateful for it.
lines.style: Reverent warmth. Opens with mild wonder. Steady pace, almost ceremonial. Softens on the gratitude, like it's something he carries lightly but truly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、麦わら帽子、二人で、かぶり、お祭り、絶対、行ったわよね、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, we both wore that straw hat together to the festival. Do you remember? We did, didn't we?
lines.style: Bright with affection. Playful lift on the shared memory. Slightly quicker pace, like she's delighted by her own recollection. Soft, conspiratorial tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、豆乳、お互いに、よく、飲むようになったわよな、ばあさん、健康、第一だな、本気で、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Lately we've both been drinking soy milk—keeping our health first, as we should. It's one of the good changes.
lines.style: Observant, gentle. Practical without being clinical. Slight warmth on 'as we should,' nodding to shared values. Even pace, grounded.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、もてる人だったわよな、覚えてる、あなた?私、本気で、絶対、ヤキモチ、絶対、本気、本気で。
lines.en: Speaking of the old days—your grandfather was quite the charmer, wasn't he? I was so jealous sometimes.
lines.style: Wry, playful edge underneath. Slight laugh in the voice. Mock exasperation wrapped in affection. Not bitter—genuinely amused at herself, at him, at time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そういや、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、今度の結婚記念日、絶対、お祝い、本気で、考えているぞ、本気、本気で、楽しみ、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: I've been thinking about how we should celebrate our anniversary this year. I want to make it special.
lines.style: Tender but purposeful. Slight quickening on the resolve. Warm, intimate tone. Voice carries quiet certainty—not grand plans, but real intention.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、窓から、外を、覗くことで、子供たち、見守ってくれたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: You know, your grandfather used to watch the children from the window. He'd stand there and keep an eye on them. Do you remember that?
lines.style: Soft, reverential. Opens with gentle wonder. Slow pace, painting the image. Voice carries quiet admiration. Trailing off slightly at the end, like she's seeing it again.
